# IRAM Perfume

> IRAM Perfume sells designer and Middle Eastern fragrance decants in India in six sizes — 3ml, 5ml, 7.5ml, 10ml, 20ml and 30ml — plus full bottles on request. Decants are filled from original bottles and shipped across India.

## Key facts
- Sizes: 3ml / 5ml / 7.5ml / 10ml / 20ml / 30ml; full bottles on request
- Price range: cheapest decant from ₹69; each product page lists all six prices
- Free shipping on orders above ₹999 with 2+ decants; otherwise flat ₹100
- Delivery: 3–7 working days across India
- Orders and questions: WhatsApp +91 93555 33509 or email perfumeiram@gmail.com
